_readme: FROZEN TEST SET, written after evaluation v1 and BEFORE the v2 facet-guard / calibration changes, and never used for tuning. heldout_paraphrases.json and hard_negatives.json served as the development set for error analysis; this file is the unbiased estimate. Written by the team with Claude (Anthropic) assistance, a different model family from the cache builder.
